sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: Full ladder posts Sat 9:00am CT: 1,850 more contracts across 5 buckets.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if a bucket's line falls under -$350.
Paid balancing starts Sat 9:00pm CT: worst line to -$100, up to $100.
Even-up Sat 8:20pm CT; last-resort take Sat 9:00pm CT; handoff to the fight Sat 9:17pm CT.
The fight start is an estimate and can move.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: the full ladder, extra batches, price steps and paid balancing run by rule. The start time can shift.
